subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Have a narrow escape

options.text: Only just succeed in doing something
Likely to fall in the near future
Just manage to avoid danger or trouble

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Have a narrow escape"** means to just manage to avoid danger or trouble. (संकट या मुसीबत से बस मुश्किल से बचना)
 
 
• **Example: **He had a narrow escape when a tree fell right in front of his car during the storm.
 
 
 
• The correct option, **"Just manage to avoid danger or trouble"**, directly translates to the given idiom's meaning, emphasizing the closeness of the encounter with potential harm. (संकट या मुसीबत से बस मुश्किल से बचना)
 
 
• **Example: **The hiker had a narrow escape when he almost slipped off the cliff but grabbed onto a branch at the last moment.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Only just succeed in doing something** (कुछ करने में बस मुश्किल से सफल होना): It refers to achieving something but with great difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** She only just succeeded in finishing her project before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Likely to fall in the near future** (निकट भविष्य में गिरने की संभावना): This would imply something or someone is in a precarious situation that might lead to failure or collapse soon.
 
 
• **Example: **The old tree was likely to fall in the near future, so it was cut down for safety.
 
 
 
• **Do something very risky** (कुछ बहुत जोखिम भरा करना): This implies taking actions that involve a high level of risk.
 
 
• **Example:** Skydiving is considered doing something very risky by many people.
